request.task: Appointment Acquisition v1 CS-001 through CS-008 remediation
request.head: 7167a2488a7a0b82f1b5df0fde6b96e1e7b869ef

findings.line: §11.3 open_degraded×TransientFailure 'from earliestSecondAt until deadline' vs §11.3 prose and §11.4 transient_reachability_downshift 'at or after earliestSecondAt'
findings.scenario: CS-003 residual: scope is open_degraded; control-plane clock is at or after deadline; designated monitor reclassifies a still-blip timeout/DNS/reset/retryable response as TransientFailure (not TransientDeadlineReached). §11.4 and §11.3 prose require that same monitor to CAS-commit RuntimeDownshift. The closed §11.3 table has no such row: 'until deadline' fails the second-failure guard, so the unlisted-pair/failed-guard rule is no write, episode stays open_degraded, selection/CTA unchanged. Conflicting expected outcomes also break CS-008's 11.3-guard / 11.4-member qualification oracle for the same input.
findings.remediation: Make the §11.3 table total and identical to §11.4: TransientFailure at or after earliestSecondAt (including at/after deadline) -> resolved_downshift + RuntimeDownshift by the designated runtime monitor; keep TransientDeadlineReached as the mandatory scheduled write. State that a late blip cannot no-write after deadline.

audit.proof_assessment: No independent proof artifacts were supplied; the PRD rewrite is the only evidence. CS-001 (exactly two scope-fact exceptions: visitor_kind_distinction on RouteShapeScope and market_location_eligibility on MarketLocationScope), CS-002 (SafetyBlock only by trusted control-plane safety identity), CS-004 (blip members excluded from general unreachability), CS-005 (open_degraded does not clear OperationallyAvailable), CS-006 (closed 13.1 allowlist), and CS-007 (status-only option probe cannot mint/return lease or target) are stated without a remaining MEDIUM+ contradiction in this slice. CS-003/CS-008 still have a closed-table vs 11.4 writer/oracle split.
residual_risks: §11.3 table-faithful runtime can miss RuntimeDownshift if a post-deadline observation is labeled TransientFailure and TransientDeadlineReached is not independently committed.
§11.4 'deterministic non-unsafe, non-blip target unreachability' is a complement, not a closed member list, so 11.4 matrix cells for that family are not uniquely oracled.
Status-probe 'freshness metadata' is not schema-closed beyond the non-minting prohibitions.
This review grants no implementation or activation authority.
